scorecard.title: College Scorecard (location, enrollment, cost; data released 2026-10-15)

cds.title: Centre College Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF, Institutional Research)

stats.notes: Fall 2025 entering class from the Common Data Set: 4,165 applied, 2,006 admitted, 357 enrolled; the residency rows (in-state 1,126 / out-of-state 1,210 / international 1,820 / unknown 9 applicants; 920 / 841 / 245 / 0 admitted; 202 / 141 / 14 / 0 enrolled) add up to the totals. International (nonresident) first-years: 1,820 applied, 245 admitted, 14 enrolled. Waitlist: 235 were offered a place and 9 were admitted; the 'number accepting' cell is blank. The ED figures (223 applications, 137 admits) are printed under 'For the Fall 2024 entering class' in the 2025-26 file and cover Early Decision I only (its note: 'Numbers represented here include only Early Decision 1 with deadline November 1'); no early action counts are given. Test scores are optional: 7.28% of enrolled first-years submitted SAT and 47.34% ACT (the SAT count cell reads 25, while the SAT score-range tables are built on 26 students, so the exact SAT count is uncertain). The GPA breakdown is the 'all enrolled students' column; the average GPA of 3.80 is reported by 98.32% of first-years. Undergraduate enrollment (1,385) and the nonresident count (60) are the 'Total Undergraduates' figures in B1/B2 (20 of the 357 first-years are nonresidents there).

cost.notes: First-year, full-time costs for the 2026-27 academic year from the Common Data Set (G1): tuition $57,500, required fees $750, on-campus food and housing $15,740 (housing $7,870 + food $7,870). Estimated expenses (G5, residents): books and supplies $850; transportation $900 and other $1,380 (other costs shown = transportation + other). Centre's international pages print the same $73,990 comprehensive fee and a total international cost of attendance of $79,455, which adds about $5,465 for required health insurance, books, transportation and personal expenses; no total is shown here because that figure is not in the CDS. Per-credit-hour charge $2,130. The CDS (H6) says institutional need-based and non-need-based aid is available to nonresidents and lists 72 nonresidents awarded aid, average $48,909 (total $3,521,466); that count is higher than the 60 nonresident undergraduates in B2 and includes merit and premier scholarships, so treat it with caution.
